body:
#: 9
Decision: Big-needs pets need their home first
Notes: The pet shop won't sell them until you own it: monkey needs a climbing tree, seal needs a pond, bear needs something big too (open question)

comments.text: 31 Oct: monkey, seal and bear also need pet yard level 3 (rule 'Big-needs pets').

title: Pet decision 9: Big-needs pets need their home first
